name: Yahoo Finance chart endpoint
rate_limits: Not published. Unofficial endpoint; it returned HTTP 429 to a plain curl request and worked with a browser style user agent (tested 2026-10-20).
history_start: SPY from 1993-01-29 (first trade date in the response).
what_it_has: Daily prices for stocks and ETFs, including an adjusted close that folds in dividends and splits. We use it for SPY, our benchmark.
simple: The back door to Yahoo Finance's price charts. It tells us how the S&P 500 fund did each day, counting dividends.
license_terms: No official API or data license. Yahoo's terms forbid commercial use and automated collection of data without permission, so our use is a gray area at best. Keep raw data private. https://legal.yahoo.com/us/en/yahoo/terms/otos/index.html
quality_notes: Unofficial and can change or disappear without notice. Adjusted closes are recomputed after each dividend, so past values shift. Fallback is FRED SP500 plus a dividend estimate.

relevance.reason: It is our only source for the dividend adjusted S&P 500 benchmark today.
